plausibility_notes: Ella admits arriving before the theft report and removing a small bottle beside Grant's glass. This joins the theft opportunity, glass access, compatible residue in an unmarked waste bottle, and financial conflict. It is the strongest released inference, although her bottle is not explicitly matched.

Ella's admission is conspicuous because almost every other final statement supplies a benign explanation while hers adds an incriminating new act. The evidence supports suspicion, but presentation does much of the solving.

Al's empty-glass mock toast and Brie's wiping before filling remain compatible with preloading an empty glass. Plaster provenance and negative food tests explain observations without excluding dosing.

Hugh, Tess and Anya's late arrival records reduce the single-person theft-and-dosing theory, conditional on authentic records and actual first arrival; they do not exclude prior access, an accomplice or receiving stolen contents.
Other characters' blocked benefits, documents and clean alternative bottles weaken specific theories but do not establish comprehensive innocence.
